title: TCA noun list
description: The program as a list: every class of a TCA package by name, kind, what it holds and what it is. The kind is the kind of the world the class subclasses; its file and layer follow from the kind.

kind.description: The kind of the world the class subclasses.

holds.description: What the class holds, in order: the names of the rows its fields are typed as; for a Scalar its primitive; for a Vocabulary its words.

is.description: What the thing is, in one sentence a domain expert accepts; the class's docstring.
